Jwt.//: Development-only key. Production must supply this via environment or a secret store.

KeyProtection.//: Wraps the Data Protection key ring, which is stored in Postgres beside the registry credentials it encrypts. Unwrapped, one database dump would carry both halves.
KeyProtection.//Provider: ScalewayKms in every environment. Development points at the fake in infra/SpaceCraft.FakeScalewayKms so the production code path is the one that runs here too.

ObjectStorage.//: MinIO from docker-compose. Staging and production point at Scaleway instead; the application speaks the same S3 API to either. ForcePathStyle is the one difference — MinIO serves bucket-in-path, Scaleway and AWS serve virtual-hosted style.

Smtp.//Mailpit: The local inbox from compose.yaml, readable at http://localhost:8025. It has no certificate, so Security is None — refused outside Development. Credentials are accepted as-is by Mailpit and only exist because a half-filled relay is an error.
